reviews.title: Runs cool on Ryzen 3600
reviews.comment: Great for cooling an AMD Ryzen 3600. Runs very quiet and at low temps around 35 idle and 60 while gaming. Has a cool little screen on the CPU cooler that can be customized even with custom images, gifs, and videos. I was unsure if I should have gotten one with 3 fans instead but it cools really well and its cheap. I will say the only problem I have had with it is the app I couldn't find any indication of where to download it on the box or inside on any of the papers but its TRCC on the Thermalright website and sometimes after a reboot the custom screen goes back to default though I suspect that is user error and I didn't tell it to save it or something.
reviews.author: Eric S

reviews.title: Very good unit for the money
reviews.comment: Very nice AIO customizable display is a definite plus!!! Very very easy to install. I got this and immediately after got a better CPU and this keeps it right at 32c idle never above 56c under max load paying at 1440p for hours!!!
reviews.author: J Dukate

reviews.title: Great budget buy
reviews.comment: The media could not be loaded.  https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/D1HMh71rk0L.mp4 https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/61fXGaZGlrL._SY256.jpg Does exactly what it’s supposed too, keeps my cpu cool. The lcd works great and can be cool to look at.
reviews.author: Lamont Chatman

reviews.title: Works great
reviews.comment: Works great! Isn’t very loud at max fan speed and keeps those high temps from AM5 chips cool. The software for the pump screen is not my favorite but isn’t horrible. Great budget AIO.
reviews.author: Jonathan Koeneke

reviews.title: Great value
reviews.comment: Easy fit. Screen is magnetic which was nice, for the price for an AIO with a screen it’s a great value. Easy cools a 14th gen i5
reviews.author: Charles Cashady
